verified_facts.text: The hotel's interiors reflect the vision of interior designer Andre Fu, conceived as a curated mansion in the heart of Wan Chai.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reflecting the unique vision of St. Regis through the eyes of interior designer André Fu, our luxury hotel in Hong Kong is a curated mansion in the heart of Wan Chai district

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in historic Wan Chai on Hong Kong Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Hong Kong is located in the heart of historic Wan Chai on Hong Kong Island

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within easy walking distance of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre and Victoria Harbour.
verified_facts.excerpt: within easy walking distance of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, as well as Victoria Harbour

verified_facts.text: Bedrooms have a curved, winged headboard capped by white lacquer panels reminiscent of traditional Wan Chai shop shutters.
verified_facts.excerpt: a gently curved, winged headboard capped by white coloured lacquer panels reminiscent of traditional Wan Chai shop shutters

verified_facts.text: In the rooms, bedside lamps recall traditional Chinese lanterns and oak dividers evoke Hong Kong's traditional shop windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bedside lamps remind us of traditional Chinese lanterns, while the oak dividers evoke Hong Kong’s traditional shop windows.

verified_facts.text: Butlers greet guests curbside and take them straight to their room for in-room check-in.
verified_facts.excerpt: your dedicated butlers will greet you curbside and welcome you into the House of Astor, whisking you into the hotel straight to your room for in-room check in.

verified_facts.text: The hotel performs a champagne sabrage ceremony every day to mark the transition from day to evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Hong Kong performs the sabrage ceremony at 5:30 pm every day to celebrate the transition from day to evening.

verified_facts.text: The sabrage saber was custom-made for the hotel by Sylvain Pintus of the French Republican Guard to replicate Napoleon's original saber.
verified_facts.excerpt: The saber is custom-made for The St. Regis Hong Kong by Sylvain Pintus, the Chief Maréchal des Logis of the French Republican Guard, to replicate the original saber used by Napoleon.

verified_facts.text: At Afternoon Tea, guests choose their own savouries and sweets from a dim sum-inspired trolley.
verified_facts.excerpt: allows guests to select their choice of savouries and sweets based on their preferences from a dim sum-inspired trolley.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar's Canto Mary, its take on the Bloody Mary, uses chen pi (dried tangerine peel), Kowloon soy sauce and Chinese five-spice.
verified_facts.excerpt: Local ingredients include "chen pi" (dried tangerine peel), Kowloon soy sauce and Chinese five-spice mix

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar serves signature cocktails inspired by New York's subway and Hong Kong's tramline.
verified_facts.excerpt: our bar in Hong Kong serves signature cocktails inspired by New York's subway and Hong Kong's tramline.

verified_facts.text: L'Envol is a French restaurant led by Chef Olivier Elzer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Led by Chef Olivier Elzer, this two-MICHELIN-starred French restaurant introduces innovative French cuisine to Wan Chai district on Hong Kong Island.

verified_facts.text: L'Envol serves over 40 cheeses on a three-tiered trolley.
verified_facts.excerpt: over 40 decadent cheeses served on a 3-tiered trolley

verified_facts.text: L'Envol's list has over 800 wine and Champagne references.
verified_facts.excerpt: over 800 wine and Champagne references

verified_facts.text: Rùn is a Cantonese restaurant led by chef Hung Chi-Kwong.
verified_facts.excerpt: The mastery of chef Hung Chi-Kwong is evident at this two-MICHELIN-starred Chinese restaurant in Hong Kong serving classic Cantonese.

verified_facts.text: At Rùn, a tea master brews a welcome tea and a digestif tea tailored to each guest's preference.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expect also a soothing welcome tea and a digestif tea brewed by our tea master tailored to each guest's preference.

verified_facts.text: The open-air Astor Terrace has a marble water feature leading to a 2.5-metre-high moon gate, a traditional element of Chinese gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Encounter a stunning marble water feature which leads to a 2.5-metre high moon gate, a traditional element in Chinese gardens.

verified_facts.text: The Astor Terrace offers over 500 cigars from 25 brands, including limited-edition St. Regis private labels.
verified_facts.excerpt: with over 500 cigars and 25 brands available including the limited edition St. Regis private labels

verified_facts.text: The Verandah Pool is a heated outdoor swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: take a swim at our heated outdoor swimming pool

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Athletic Club fitness center has Technogym equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our world-class fitness center features state-of-the-art equipment from Technogym.

verified_facts.text: The spa uses products from 001 Skincare London and 3LAB.
verified_facts.excerpt: bespoke treatments using result-driven products from luxury skincare brands – 001 Skincare London and 3LAB

verified_facts.text: The bar's glassware was created exclusively by Cristallerie de Paris, its pattern a tribute to Mrs Caroline Astor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Created exclusively by Cristallerie de Paris which specialises in producing high quality tableware and decorative objects, the pattern of the glassware at The St. Regis Bar is a tribute to the rich St. Regis legacy

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic city and harbour views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows look out to panoramic city and harbour views

verified_facts.text: The minibar includes fresh fruit juices and Ruinart Blanc de Blancs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge at a minibar with fresh fruit juices, Ruinart Blanc de Blancs and other hand-selected drinks

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Hong Kong International Airport is approximately 39.3 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: HKG is located approximately 39.3 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Hong Kong.

verified_facts.text: The hotel received a 2025 Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Rating.
verified_facts.excerpt: 2025 Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Rating

verified_facts.text: Function spaces are reached by private elevator from the hotel entrance and the basement car park.
verified_facts.excerpt: function spaces accessible via private elevator from the hotel entrance and the basement car park

verified_facts.text: Wan Chai mixes hip bars and restaurants with old tenement buildings and hidden temples among skyscrapers.
verified_facts.excerpt: where hip bars and restaurants mix with old tenement buildings and hidden temples among towering skyscrapers
